lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like array of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately four identifiable vertical columns and three horizontal rows within the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of spots, creating an intersection pattern where the spots are centered within the vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, showing a light-to-dark vertical gradient indicating physical relief.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of smaller, randomly distributed high-luminance spots is located anterior to the first gill slit, transitioning into the larger, ordered grid pattern on the lateral flank.
